program_gaps.evidence: DescribeCoverage silently substitutes E,N when fewer than two axisLabels are observed.
program_gaps.required: Require two explicit spatial axes from the selected CoverageDescription; no fallback.

program_gaps.evidence: GetCoverage neither requests nor records an interpolation method.
program_gaps.required: Discover supported interpolation, request an allowed method and persist it.

program_gaps.evidence: Sampler records raster resolution but does not require exactly 1m by 1m before metric extraction.
program_gaps.required: Require a 1m x 1m affine transform within strict tolerance.

program_gaps.evidence: Output declares ODN without proving a vertical datum identifier from response metadata.
program_gaps.required: Observe and validate ODN/EPSG:5701-compatible vertical lineage.

program_gaps.evidence: DescribeCoverage parsing does not verify returned CoverageId/domainSet identity and collects axisLabels globally rather than from the selected coverage grid.
program_gaps.required: Verify returned CoverageId, domainSet, CRS, grid axes and bounds belong to the selected coverage.

program_gaps.evidence: Returned raster bounds, transform alignment, band count and range unit are not fail-closed bound to the requested padded polygon subset.
program_gaps.required: Verify returned bounds cover the requested subset, grid alignment is correct, one numeric elevation band is present and units are metres.

program_gaps.evidence: Crosschecker does not enforce 200x200, exact 50m transform, 10km bounds, companion pairing or nested/member hash lineage.
program_gaps.required: Enforce documented grid/header/tile/companion contracts and persist all archive/member hashes.

program_gaps.evidence: Multiple ASC/TXT files matching one tile are concatenated, so duplicate editions can overweight the Terrain50 median.
program_gaps.required: Require exactly one canonical ASC grid per required tile and reject duplicate tile hashes/editions.

program_gaps.evidence: Fresh catalogue bytes are hashed but seed-provided authority URLs and filenames are not verified as entries in that current catalogue.
program_gaps.required: Parse the current catalogue and bind each authority name, filename and download URL to the current publication.

program_gaps.evidence: GML/XML members are flattened to basename without a collision check, permitting silent overwrite of duplicate member names.
program_gaps.required: Preserve safe relative paths or reject duplicate output basenames before extraction.

program_gaps.evidence: Site examples do not require metric-semantics fields or unique IDs, and source rows require only non-empty publisher/URL rather than unique official HTTPS identities.
program_gaps.required: Require unique example/source IDs, exact metric-semantics fields and approved official HTTPS source domains.
